name: Tip & Split
subtitle: Fair bills in seconds.

description:
The bill arrives, everyone reaches for their phone — and you're already done. Tip & Split works out the tip, the total and exactly what each person owes, live, as you type.

Punch in the bill on the big built-in keypad, tap a tip percentage or dial in your own, and choose how many people are sharing. The receipt at the bottom keeps a clear, honest breakdown: bill, tip, total and each person's share.

Hate counting coins? Turn on Round Up and everyone pays a clean whole number — Tip & Split shows you the real tip percentage that works out to, so the server never loses out.
whatsNew: New receipt view, custom tip slider up to 50%, and a Round Up option that shows the true tip percentage.
